title: Comparison with the Stacks Project adic constructible category
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and let
$\operatorname{Res}\colon D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_{E,X})\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},(\cO_E)_X)$ be restriction
of scalars along the map from the constant sheaf. Let $\Dc(X,\cO_E)$ be the full subcategory of
$D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},(\cO_E)_X)$ of \stacks{09C1}: derived $\pi_E$-complete complexes $L$ such that
$L\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\cO_E}\cO_E/\pi_E$ has finite Tor dimension and constructible cohomology
sheaves (pulled back from $X_{\mathrm{ét}}$). Then for $K\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_{E,X})$:
$$
K\in\Dbc(X,\cO_E)\iff\operatorname{Res}K\in\Dc(X,\cO_E),
$$
and $\operatorname{Res}$ restricts to an equivalence $\Dbc(X,\cO_E)\simeq\Dc(X,\cO_E)$.

proof.text: Transport boundedness by the specified exact faithful realization and homology by its natural homology comparison. Apply the heart-level scalar-model comparison degree by degree.
Apply the cohomological adic criterion to the transported complex. The complete-object and residue comparisons identify the resulting adic predicate with stacksConstructible of Res K.

Restrict the complete-object equivalence to the selected full subcategories. Full faithfulness follows from their fully faithful inclusions. A Stacks constructible object has a complete preimage, and the membership equivalence makes that preimage bounded constructible. Compose the inclusion isomorphisms to identify its forward functor with Res.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_models_stacks (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    (∀ K, constantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X K ↔
      stacksConstructible l E X ((restriction l E X).obj K)) ∧
    ∃ e : ConstantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X ≌
        (stacksConstructible l E X).FullSubcategory,
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ (stacksConstructible l E X).ι ≅
        (constantModelBoundedConstructible (integersObj l E) X).ι ⋙ restriction l E X)
lean.note: The auxiliary definitions spell out the Stacks category introduced in the statement and the specified restriction functor. Completeness uses the existing local predicate after sectionwise transport to an equivalent small site. Coefficients and maps are constructed from actual constant sheaves, constant continuous functions, and the scalar quotient; no comparison or functor is postulated.
